thread:
Maya (AE): Hey team — PraxisHealth POC in Canada hit multiple blockers. They pinned `red-infer-3b-v1` to ca-north and are seeing a mix: initial 404 (model_not_found), then 429s when we changed routing. They also asked about Dedicated in-region pricing for ~3k reqs/min and strict HSM-backed KMS + SOC2 evidence. Can we swarm?
Tom (Support Eng): Paste the error snippets + which endpoint (hosted/dedicated)?
Maya (AE): Hosted right now. Two payloads: 1) 404 on pin: `HTTP 404 {"error":"model_not_found","message":"artifact red-infer-3b-v1 not in ca-north"}`. 2) After I asked to enable fallback to nearest region, customer saw intermittent 429s: `HTTP 429 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","detail":"per-region quota exceeded"}`.
Irfan (Infra): 404 means the artifact wasn't replicated to ca-north. We had a replication window earlier and a partial failure. The 429s are expected when traffic spikes to fallback region because quotas are per-region by default.
ops-bot: replication-sync job 2025-06-02T08:12Z -> PARTIAL_FAIL (upstream timeout). retry scheduled.
Leah (Security): PraxisHealth flagged PHI concerns. Cross-region fallback requires explicit written consent + DPA amendment. HSM-backed KMS is supported for Dedicated but provisioning requires contract+onboarding and a brief security review (3-7 business days). Also they asked for SOC2 report and pen test summary — we can provide those to their security team.
Maya (AE): Good. They want two options to decide quickly: A) Temporary cross-region fallback with strict audit logs and redact-in-transit for logging, B) Fast-track Dedicated in ca-north (HSM) estimate and onboarding timeline. Need numbers I can give them in the next 2 hours.
Tom (Support Eng): For option A: we can enable region-preferred -> fallback to us-east. I'll add audit headers and set log redact flag to remove prompt text from raw logs. Note: latency p95 will increase (~100-160ms) and token billing unchanged. Also need their consent for PHI cross-border.
Irfan (Infra): For option B: Dedicated in-region with HSM: rough resource sizing for sustained 3k reqs/min (assume avg 25 tokens/request): recommend 6x A100 reserved with autoscale headroom and burst. Ops estimate: provisioning + HSM onboarding ~5 business days if capacity available; expedited replication of artifact to ca-north ~24-48h once infra approves. I'll get a formal quote but ballpark monthly committed $AAk-$BBk (include network + HSM).
Leah (Security): I'll prepare exact wording for the consent (cross-border PHI for PoC) and the HSM onboarding checklist. We also need the customer's legal contact.
Maya (AE): Customer legal will only accept minimal footprint. Can we do a staged PoC: start with Option A limited to synthetic/test data (no real PHI) while we process Dedicated + HSM? They asked whether synthetic eval is acceptable to show functionality.
Tom (Support Eng): Yes — strongly recommend synthetic first. Also run eval harness on `red-infer-3b-quant` variant (if available) to show output drift. Quantization can change output length and tokenization; I'll produce a 20-sample diff.
Irfan (Infra): Kicker: pinned model IDs don't auto-fallback unless a compatible regional artifact exists or we enable cross-region fallthrough. If replication doesn't finish, pinned calls will keep 404ing. I'll open a P0 replication ticket and try to prioritize artifact push.
ops-bot: replication ticket created #R-2219. Priority: P0 for PraxisHealth POC.
Maya (AE): Action items: 1) Tom — quick eval diffs between hosted fallback quant variant and current model; 2) Irfan — escalate replication + formal Dedicated quote and ETA; 3) Leah — draft consent + collect SOC2/pen-test docs to share. I'll relay both options to PraxisHealth and ask for legal contact.
Tom (Support Eng): Starting eval run now. Will post short diffs in ~45m.
Irfan (Infra): Escalated to infra on-call. If we can push artifact, pinned calls will succeed and avoid fallback 429s. If not, fallback is temporary but requires consent.
Leah (Security): Drafting consent text and list of deliverables (SOC2 report, penetration test summary, DPA amendment). Will link docs once ready.
Maya (AE): Thanks — please @mention me in the replies. I'll update customer in 1h with Option A (synthetic fallback + consent) and Option B (Dedicated + HSM timeline).
Tom (Support Eng): Eval quick note: quant variant shows ~10% shorter average token output on sample prompts; content fidelity mostly preserved but few rephrases. I'll paste sample diffs shortly.
Irfan (Infra): Replication job status: IN_PROGRESS (job id R-2219). ETA 36h if no further failures.
Maya (AE): Great. I'll request legal contact from PraxisHealth and keep them on the short synthetic fallback while we await Dedicated timeline. :thumbsup:
